summary: The note is a short biographical entry on Ramón Carrillo. It states that he was born in Santiago del Estero, studied at the University of Buenos Aires, and earned a medicine degree in 1929 with a Gold Medal as the best student in his class.
one_line: Biographical note on Ramón Carrillo, an Argentine physician born in Santiago del Estero who graduated in medicine in 1929.
key_facts: Ramón Carrillo was born in Santiago del Estero.
Ramón Carrillo attended the University of Buenos Aires.
Ramón Carrillo obtained a degree in Medicine in 1929.
Ramón Carrillo received a Gold Medal as the best student in his class when he obtained his Medicine degree.
